text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S visited an Umamusume 
training club as a one-day coach. Her 
partner for the day wasâ

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
“—Just like you saw. Keep your gaze 
straight ahead, and make sure your upper 
body stays relaxed.”

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Alright, next. Kris S-san, if you would.

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume Girls
text_block_list.text: (*Jolt...*) (*Murmur murmur...*)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...I—can feel it. Everyone—has—such 
wonderful talent.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
So――I want you to let me help. So that 
everyone――can run happily.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, everyone. Kris S-san is a 
kind person.

text_block_list.name: Dog-Like Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Teacher Kris S~~! How was that just now~~?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Great... A stable—form.

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume Girls
text_block_list.text:
—Aww, lucky you, getting praised by 
Teacher! —I'm running next~~!
choice_data_list: Kris S, you've gotten quite popular, huh~

Symboli Kris S, you're quite the popular 
one now, huh~

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, you're so good at teaching. 
Hehe... I really look up to you."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to Cesario's... help. 
Still, hearing you say that makes me... 
happy.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all— Oh? That girl over there, 
she's all alone...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Aren't you going to run?

text_block_list.name: Pouting Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...It's useless anyway. My body is so 
weak...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
That doesn't necessarily mean it's 
pointless. Aren't there plenty of seniors 
who excel despite having frail bodies?

text_block_list.name: Pouting Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"No way, that can't be... There's no way 
someone like that exists..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Cesario. I... will talk to this child.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Kris S-san...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Listen, please—... I was—the same. My 
body was—... weak."

text_block_list.name: Pouting Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? It doesn't look like that to me, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I have changed—no—it changed me. My 
encounter—with Master—changed who I am.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...There is something I want you to see. 
—Will you come with me?"

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —The final set! Doctor, you can do it—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Symboli Kris S had young 
Umamusume watch her training session with 
Dr. Reits.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Guh...! —Haaaaaaah!
choice_data_list: We did it! It's a new record!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... Thank you for today, too. 
With this, I'm one step closer...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Ah... it shouldn't be too far off. The day 
I achieve... the evolution of my running.

text_block_list.name: Pouting Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Do you... really think so? That if I 
try hard... I can run even better than 
before...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Possibility lies before those who do not 
give up. Right within reach――if you just 
stretch out your hand.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I am—just like the Professor. Borrowing 
help—and reaching out my hand.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"You too—surely, you'll reach it. Because 
there is an Umamusume right here—cheering 
for you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I drop off the young Umamusume at the 
development club. Her expression looks 
somewhat brighter than it did before 
visiting the tour—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Goodbye, and take care. If anything 
troubles you again—come consult me.

text_block_list.name: Pouting Umamusume
text_block_list.text: (...*bows*. *patter patter*...!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Was I able—to guide them? Just as—my 
master once did...?"
choice_data_list: I'm sure you could've done it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —...I see. Then—Mission Accomplished.
